g.text: Beta roadmap: nine stages, then the Zuhal gate
v1.0.0 Zuhal: the readiness gate. Scope decided; no date. Beta stays 0.x until the owner says go.

g.title: Bazaar roadmap: Beta stages to v1.0.0 Zuhal

g.text: Roadmap: from Beta to v1.0.0 Zuhal
Beta stages in order. v1.0.0 ships when the owner judges Bazaar ready, not on a date.
v1 scope still open (version 1.0.0, plain SemVer). Anything tentative is marked *.
